note.note:
I’m ready to draft the SOAP note, but I need the actual content of the transcript and the DDx.

Please provide:
- The doctor–patient transcript (text of the encounter).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) list in JSON format (as used by your diagnostic agent).

Once I have these, I will produce a structured SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, medications, allergies, social history.
- Objective: relevant physical findings, vitals, and any investigations if available.
- Assessment & Plan: for each issue/diagnosis (up to as many as present), including consistent differentials from the DDx, planned investigations, treatments, and referrals.
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, any conflicts between transcript and DDx (marking “conflict noted”), and any commentary on transcript quality if applicable.

Guidelines I will follow:
- Rely on transcript as the primary factual source.
- Use DDx to enrich reasoning only if consistent with the transcript; if conflicting, present both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Do not invent data (e.g., vitals, dosages) beyond what is in the transcript or DDx.
- Use American English, concise, professional tone.
- Medication entries will include “dose/route/frequency not documented” if those details are not provided.

Please paste the actual transcript and the DDx JSON.
